description:
## Goal

Prove steady-state cleanup: after StrictMode startup finishes correctly, a real App unmount removes the live lifecycle's listeners exactly once without re-cleaning stale ownership or repeating startup.

**Triage:** ready-for-agent

## Background

After the StrictMode probe cycle, stale run 1 should have removed `T1` and `R1`, while live run 2 owns stored `unlistenTransition` and `unlistenRefresh` handles (`src/App.tsx:183-184`, `202`, `214`). Cleanup 2 at `src/App.tsx:270-274` must invoke only those live handles. The stale lifecycle's cleanup has already run and its late handles should already have been removed by post-await checks.

This task complements the pending-unmount case by covering the normal mounted steady state followed by an actual unmount.

## Work

Using the focused App StrictMode harness:

1. Complete all four registrations in any deterministic valid order.
2. Before unmount, assert `T1` and `R1` have unlistened once, `T2` and `R2` remain live, and startup Issue/Workspace reads each ran once.
3. Unmount App.
4. Flush cleanup and any queued work.

Assert after unmount:

- `T2` and `R2` unlisten exactly once;
- `T1` and `R1` remain at exactly one unlisten call, proving cleanup 2 does not own stale handles;
- no listener remains active;
- `loadIssueExplorerStateFromTauRpc()` remains at one call;
- TauRPC `workspace_state()` remains at one call;
- cleanup produces no warnings or unhandled rejections.

## Guardrails

- Assert pre-unmount steady state before testing cleanup so failures identify registration versus unmount defects.
- Do not use gate deduplication as a substitute for listener ownership assertions.
- No production, Rust, or WebDriver changes are expected.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Pre-unmount state has only `T2`/`R2` live and exactly one startup dispatch.
- [ ] Real unmount removes `T2`/`R2` once each.
- [ ] Stale unlisten counts do not change during live cleanup.
- [ ] Startup call counts do not change during cleanup.
- [ ] No listeners or asynchronous warnings remain.
- [ ] Focused tests, full frontend tests, `pnpm check`, and `pnpm doctor` pass.
title: Test unmount after StrictMode listener registration completes
